`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.riemann_coe_ratHom`

The map ratHom P:ℚ→O_P is the canonical rational embedding with codomain restricted to O_P. Let K be any field of characteristic zero. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). Let P be any such place. For every q∈ℚ, the image in K of ratHom P q∈O_P equals q.

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). Also supply a curve-field instance, meaning that there exists s∈K transcendental over ℚ with K finite-dimensional over ℚ(s). Write (f), (f)₀ and (f)∞ for the finite-support divisors of coefficients ord_P(f), max(0,ord_P(f)) and max(0,−ord_P(f)), respectively; these are the principal divisor, zero divisor and pole divisor of f. By the order convention all three divisors of the zero function are the zero divisor whose coefficients are all zero. Write [P] for the divisor of coefficient one at P and zero elsewhere. For every divisor A and f∈M.K, f∈L(A) if and only if f=0 or −A(P)≤P.ord(f) at every place P.

import Definitions.Def_FermatFunctionDivisors

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

namespace Place

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (P : Place K)

@[simp] theorem riemann_coe_ratHom (q : ℚ) : (P.ratHom q : K) = q := rfl

@[simp] theorem riemann_residue_ratHom (q : ℚ) :
    P.residue (P.ratHom q) = (q : P.ResidueField) :=
  map_ratCast (P.residue.comp P.ratHom) q

end Place

namespace RiemannDimension

open IsLocalRing

variable {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
variable [hCurve : IsCurveField M.K]
include M hDVR hCurve

local notation "L" => riemannRochSpace M hDVR
local notation "ell" => riemannEll M hDVR
local notation "pdiv" => functionDivisor M hDVR
local notation "degree" => divisorDegree M

theorem mem_L {A : Divisor M} {f : M.K} : f ∈ L A ↔ f = 0 ∨ ∀ P : Place M.K, -A P ≤ P.ord f :=
  by
  simp only [mem_riemannRochSpace, ord_eq_placeOrd]

theorem mem_L_of_ne_zero {A : Divisor M} {f : M.K} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f ∈ L A ↔ 0 ≤ A + pdiv f := by
  rw [mem_L, or_iff_right hf]
  refine forall_congr' fun P ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, functionDivisor_apply, ord_eq_placeOrd]
  omega

theorem L_mono {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) : L A ≤ L B :=
  riemannRochSpace_mono M hDVR h

/-! ### Transport along principal divisors -/

theorem mul_mem_L {A : Divisor M} {z f : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hf : f ∈ L (A + pdiv z)) :
    f * z ∈ L A := by
  rw [mem_L] at hf ⊢
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · simp
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · simp [hf0]
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  have := hf P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, functionDivisor_apply, ord_eq_placeOrd] at this
  rw [P.ord_mul hf0 hz]
  omega

theorem mul_inv_mem_L {A : Divisor M} {z g : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hg : g ∈ L A) :
    g * z⁻¹ ∈ L (A + pdiv z) := by
  rw [mem_L] at hg ⊢
  rcases hg with rfl | hg
  · simp
  by_cases hg0 : g = 0
  · simp [hg0]
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  have := hg P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, functionDivisor_apply, ord_eq_placeOrd]
  rw [P.ord_mul hg0 (inv_ne_zero hz), P.ord_inv]
  omega

/-- Multiplication by `z ≠ 0` identifies `L(A + pdiv z)` with `L(A)`. -/
noncomputable def mulEquiv (A : Divisor M) {z : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) : L (A + pdiv z) ≃ₗ[ℚ] L A where
  toFun f := ⟨f * z, mul_mem_L M hDVR hz f.2⟩
  invFun g := ⟨g * z⁻¹, mul_inv_mem_L M hDVR hz g.2⟩
  map_add' f g := Subtype.ext (add_mul _ _ _)
  map_smul' q f := Subtype.ext (smul_mul_assoc _ _ _)
  left_inv f := Subtype.ext (by simp [hz])
  right_inv g := Subtype.ext (by simp [hz])

/-- `ℓ` is invariant under linear equivalence. -/
theorem ell_add_pdiv (A : Divisor M) {z : M.K} (hz : z ≠ 0) : ell (A + pdiv z) = ell A :=
  (mulEquiv M hDVR A hz).finrank_eq

/-! ### Adding a place -/

section Step

variable {A : Divisor M} {P : Place M.K} {π : M.K}

theorem ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one (hπ : P.ord π = 1) : π ≠ 0 := by
  rintro rfl; simp at hπ

theorem zpow_mul_mem (hπ : P.ord π = 1) {f : M.K} (hf : f ∈ L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) :
    π ^ (A P + 1) * f ∈ P.1 := by
  rw [mem_L] at hf
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · simp
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · simp [hf0]
  apply P.mem_of_ord_nonneg
  rw [P.ord_mul (zpow_ne_zero _ (ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one M hDVR hπ)) hf0, Place.ord_zpow, hπ]
  have := hf P
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this
  omega

variable (A P) in
/-- The `ℚ`-linear map `L(A + P) → κ(P)`, `f ↦ (π^{A(P)+1} f)(P)`. -/
noncomputable def residueMap (hπ : P.ord π = 1) :
    L (A + Finsupp.single P 1) →ₗ[ℚ] P.ResidueField where
  toFun f := P.residue ⟨π ^ (A P + 1) * f, zpow_mul_mem M hDVR hπ f.2⟩
  map_add' f g := by
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [mul_add]
  map_smul' q f := by
    rw [RingHom.id_apply, Rat.smul_def q (P.residue _), ← P.riemann_residue_ratHom q, ← map_mul]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [SetLike.val_smul, Rat.smul_def, MulMemClass.coe_mul, Place.riemann_coe_ratHom]
    ring

theorem mem_ker_residueMap (hπ : P.ord π = 1) (f : L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) :
    f ∈ LinearMap.ker (residueMap M hDVR A P hπ) ↔ (f : M.K) ∈ L A := by
  classical
  have hπ0 := ne_zero_of_ord_eq_one M hDVR hπ
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  change P.residue _ = 0 ↔ _
  rw [P.residue_eq_zero_iff]
  by_cases hf0 : (f : M.K) = 0
  · simp only [hf0, mul_zero]
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ Or.inl rfl, fun _ ↦ by
      rw [show (⟨0, _⟩ : P.1) = 0 from rfl]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _⟩
  have hne : π ^ (A P + 1) * (f : M.K) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0) hf0
  rw [← P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨_, zpow_mul_mem M hDVR hπ f.2⟩) hne]
  change 0 < P.ord (π ^ (A P + 1) * (f : M.K)) ↔ _
  rw [P.ord_mul (zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0) hf0, Place.ord_zpow, hπ, mem_L, or_iff_right hf0]
  have hf := f.2
  rw [mem_L, or_iff_right hf0] at hf
  constructor
  · intro h Q
    by_cases hQ : Q = P
    · subst hQ; omega
    · have := hf Q
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hQ),
        add_zero] at this
      exact this
  · intro h
    have := h P
    omega

/-- **Adding a place** (Stichtenoth, Lemma 1.4.8): if `L(A)` is finite-dimensional, so is
`L(A + P)`, and `ℓ(A + P) ≤ ℓ(A) + deg P`. -/
theorem step (A : Divisor M) (P : Place M.K) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) ∧
      ell (A + Finsupp.single P 1) ≤ ell A + P.degree := by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := P.exists_ord_eq_one
  set φ := residueMap M hDVR A P hπ
  have hle : L A ≤ L (A + Finsupp.single P 1) :=
    L_mono M hDVR (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one))
  have hker : LinearMap.ker φ = (L A).comap (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)).subtype := by
    ext f
    exact mem_ker_residueMap M hDVR hπ f
  let e : LinearMap.ker φ ≃ₗ[ℚ] L A :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hker).trans (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hle)
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) := e.symm.finiteDimensional
  have hfin : FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P 1)) := by
    refine ⟨Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker φ ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact IsNoetherian.noetherian _
    · rw [top_inf_eq]
      exact Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp (inferInstance : FiniteDimensional ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ))
  letI := hfin
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker φ
  have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range φ) ≤ P.degree := Submodule.finrank_le _
  rw [e.finrank_eq] at h1
  unfold riemannEll
  omega

theorem step_nat (P : Place M.K) (m : ℕ) (A : Divisor M) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ))) ∧
      (ell (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ)) : ℤ) ≤ ell A + m * P.degree := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, Finsupp.single_zero, add_zero]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
    letI := h1
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := step M hDVR (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ)) P
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, Finsupp.single_add, ← add_assoc]
    refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
    have : ((m : ℤ) + 1) * P.degree = m * P.degree + P.degree := by ring
    omega

theorem aux (D : Divisor M) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (A : Divisor M) [FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A + D)) ∧ (ell (A + D) : ℤ) ≤ ell A + (degree D) := by
  classical
  induction D using Finsupp.induction generalizing A with
  | zero =>
    rw [add_zero]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, by simp⟩
  | single_add P b f hPf _ ih =>
    have hfP : f P = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hPf
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := by
      have := hD P
      simpa [hfP] using this
    have hf : 0 ≤ f := by
      intro Q
      by_cases hQ : Q = P
      · subst hQ; simp [hfP]
      · have := hD Q
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, Ne.symm hQ] using this
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hb
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := step_nat M hDVR P m A
    letI := h1
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := ih hf (A + Finsupp.single P (m : ℤ))
    rw [← add_assoc]
    refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
    rw [divisorDegree_add, divisorDegree_single]
    omega

end Step

/-! ### Finite-dimensionality and the dimension estimate -/

section PrincipalDegree

variable (hDegreeZero : ∀ f : M.K,
  divisorDegree M (functionDivisor M hDVR f) = 0)
include hDegreeZero

theorem negativeSpace {A : Divisor M} (hA : degree A < 0) : L A = ⊥ := by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro f hf
  have hfzero : f = 0 := by
    by_contra hf0
    have hnonneg := divisorDegree_nonneg M ((mem_L_of_ne_zero M hDVR hf0).mp hf)
    have hadd := divisorDegree_add M A (functionDivisor M hDVR f)
    have hzero := hDegreeZero f
    change 0 ≤ divisorDegree M (A + functionDivisor M hDVR f) at hnonneg
    omega
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℚ).mpr hfzero

/-- Every Riemann–Roch space is finite-dimensional (Stichtenoth, Proposition 1.4.9). -/
theorem finiteDimensional_L (A : Divisor M) : FiniteDimensional ℚ (L A) := by
  obtain P0 : Place M.K := Classical.arbitrary _
  set n : ℤ := |(degree A)| + 1
  have hn : 0 ≤ n := by positivity
  have hdeg : degree (A - Finsupp.single P0 n) < 0 := by
    rw [divisorDegree_sub, divisorDegree_single]
    have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ P0.degree := by exact_mod_cast P0.degree_pos
    have h2 := le_abs_self (degree A)
    nlinarith
  have hbot := negativeSpace M hDVR hDegreeZero hdeg
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ (L (A - Finsupp.single P0 n)) := by
    rw [hbot]; infer_instance
  letI := this
  have := (aux M hDVR (Finsupp.single P0 n) (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr hn)
    (A - Finsupp.single P0 n)).1
  rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this

/-- **Dimension estimate** (Stichtenoth, Lemma 1.4.8): for `A ≤ B`,
`ℓ(B) ≤ ℓ(A) + (deg B - deg A)`. -/
theorem ell_le_of_le {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) :
    (ell B : ℤ) ≤ ell A + ((degree B) - (degree A)) := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_L M hDVR hDegreeZero A
  have := (aux M hDVR (B - A) (sub_nonneg.mpr h) A).2
  rwa [add_sub_cancel, divisorDegree_sub] at this

/-- For `A ≤ B`, `deg A - ℓ(A) ≤ deg B - ℓ(B)`. -/
theorem degreeDefect_mono {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) :
    (degree A) - ell A ≤ (degree B) - ell B := by
  have := ell_le_of_le M hDVR hDegreeZero h
  omega

theorem ell_mono {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) : ell A ≤ ell B := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_L M hDVR hDegreeZero B
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono (L_mono M hDVR h)

theorem ell_eq_zero_of_deg_neg {A : Divisor M} (hA : (degree A) < 0) : ell A = 0 := by
  rw [riemannEll, negativeSpace M hDVR hDegreeZero hA, finrank_bot]

theorem ell_eq_zero_iff {A : Divisor M} : ell A = 0 ↔ L A = ⊥ := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_L M hDVR hDegreeZero A
  exact Submodule.finrank_eq_zero

theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_L {A : Divisor M} (h : ell A ≠ 0) : ∃ f ∈ L A, f ≠ 0 :=
  (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mp (mt (ell_eq_zero_iff M hDVR hDegreeZero).mpr h)

/-- If `L(A) ≠ 0`, then `A` is linearly equivalent to an effective divisor. -/
theorem exists_nonneg_add_pdiv {A : Divisor M} (h : ell A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z : M.K, z ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ A + pdiv z := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := exists_ne_zero_mem_L M hDVR hDegreeZero h
  exact ⟨z, hz0, (mem_L_of_ne_zero M hDVR hz0).mp hz⟩

/-- `ℓ(A) ≤ max 0 (deg A + ℓ(0))` (Stichtenoth, Lemma 1.4.10). -/
theorem ell_le_max (A : Divisor M) : (ell A : ℤ) ≤ max 0 ((degree A) + ell (0 : Divisor M)) := by
  by_cases h : ell A = 0
  · rw [h]; exact le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hA⟩ := exists_nonneg_add_pdiv M hDVR hDegreeZero h
  have := ell_le_of_le M hDVR hDegreeZero hA
  rw [ell_add_pdiv M hDVR A hz, divisorDegree_add, hDegreeZero, divisorDegree_zero] at this
  exact (by omega : (ell A : ℤ) ≤ (degree A) + ell (0 : Divisor M)).trans (le_max_right _ _)
